gitCommit.subject: ci: run Playwright selectively on UI/presentation changes (#192)
gitCommit.body:
ci: run Playwright selectively on UI/presentation changes (#192)

* ci: run Playwright selectively on UI/presentation changes

Wire the e2e (Playwright) suite into CI as a separate job that only runs
when the view layer changed, detected via dorny/paths-filter:

- `changes` job outputs `ui=true` for src/app/** (minus src/app/api/**),
  components/features/hooks, design tokens, CSS, tailwind/postcss/next
  config, and e2e/playwright config.
- `e2e` job runs only `if: needs.changes.outputs.ui == 'true'`. When the UI
  isn't touched it's skipped (reported as success), so it can be a required
  check without blocking server/db-only PRs.
- Reuses e2e/fixtures/test-db.sh (postgres:16 on :5433) via Playwright's
  globalSetup; installs chromium + webkit (mobile devices are WebKit).

The one-line comment tweak in src/app/page.tsx is a UI-path change that
exercises this new gate end-to-end on its own PR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: grant pull-requests:read to the UI-detection job

dorny/paths-filter lists the PR's changed files via the GitHub API, which
fails with 'Resource not accessible by integration' under the repo's default
read-only token. Scope contents+pull-requests read to the changes job.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: always keep e2e report + render inline summary dashboard

Previously the Playwright report uploaded only on failure, so green runs
kept nothing. Now:
- upload the full HTML report (traces/screenshots) on every non-cancelled
  run as the 'playwright-report' artifact (downloadable dashboard);
- add a JSON reporter and render a pass/fail/flaky/skip/duration table into
  the GitHub Actions run summary (inline dashboard, no download).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test: add v8 coverage reporting to vitest

Add @vitest/coverage-v8 and a coverage block (html + json-summary +
text-summary). Reflects unit/component tests only; the DB integration suite
runs in a separate CI job and is not counted here. Prep for publishing the
coverage report to the Pages dashboard.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: run coverage in the gate job and upload it as an artifact

gate now runs test:ci with --coverage and uploads the coverage/ report
(unit/component only). Feeds the Pages dashboard's coverage page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: add Pages dashboard landing page

Static landing for the test-reports site: links to the e2e and coverage
reports, notes that coverage excludes the DB suite. Copied to the site root
by the deploy-report job.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: publish e2e + coverage + trends dashboard to gh-pages

deploy-report job (main only) assembles a reports site and pushes it to
gh-pages with plain git + GITHUB_TOKEN — no third-party Pages action. Each
deploy overwrites only the report subdir it built, so the other survives.
append-history.mjs records a metrics row per main deploy (coverage %, e2e
pass/duration) and regenerates a trends page for current-vs-past comparison.

Verified locally: history dedupe + carry-forward, and keep-files across a
non-UI deploy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
